transcript.content: Hello, thank you for coming in today. What brings you to see me?

Hi. Well, I'm here because... the thought of seeing a rat has gotten so bad that I just can't do parts of my cleaning job anymore. I mean, I know it's usually just an old building or a regular trash room, and it's not really dangerous, but... I just can't make myself go in there.
What is it about the rats that frightens you the most?

I don't really know how to explain it. It's not that I think they're going to attack me or anything like that. It's just... I don't know, the way they look, the way they move. Just the idea of one scurrying past me or being near me makes my skin crawl. I can't really put my finger on one specific thing, it's just the whole idea of them being there that completely panics me.
How long have you had this intense fear of rats?

It's been about two years now. It started right around the time I moved into this older apartment building. A lot of the tenants there kept talking about seeing rats in the basement and the alleys, and... well, ever since then, it's just been a constant thing for me.

inference_history.note: Initial presentation of severe fear and avoidance of rats interfering with occupational functioning, consistent primarily with specific phobia, but needing differentiation from agoraphobia or obsessive-compulsive disorder.
